summary: Blocked before a verdict could be produced: A persistent selection/transform gizmo appears to remain active on page load or after prior actions, and it is intercepting pointer events at the canvas center. Because the automation framework resolves clicks to the element center, every click lands on the gizmo instead of the drawing surface, so pixels cannot be placed away from the center. This suggests a hosting-side UI state issue: stale selection state, an overlay with higher z-index/pointer-eve… Target: environment default (http://127.0.0.1:3150).
